detached_structure.evidence: A separate dark-roofed building sits southwest of the main house, partly under tree canopy and shadow, with a smaller outbuilding or shed nearby.

signals.notes: The central house has a tan/brown shingle roof with a round patio or deck on its west side. It is heavily surrounded by mature trees, and the paved driveway to the northeast belongs mostly to the neighboring lot.
